@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+# Postmortem\n\n## Root Cause\nThe previous commit (9308821) introduced threaded gunicorn workers (threads=8) while simultaneously heavily restricting the database connection pool (pool_size=1, max_overflow=0). This led to severe connection pool contention since 8 threads were trying to share a single database connection concurrently, causing HTTP request processing to queue while waiting for a database connection, leading to a spike in p99 latency to over 1.5s.\n\n## Evidence\n- Alert showed high p99 latency on the booklogr-api service (1.505s).\n- Prometheus metrics grouped by path showed the latency was concentrated on the `/v1/books` and `/v1/books/search` endpoints, which heavily use the database.\n- `git log` showed a recent commit "Reduce DB connection footprint" (9308821) which set `SQLALCHEMY_ENGINE_OPTIONS` with `pool_size: 1` and `max_overflow: 0` and changed gunicorn workers to `gthread` with `threads = 8`.\n\n## Fix\nReverted commit 9308821 to remove the restrictive connection pool settings and revert back to default worker class and thread settings.
